critical.issue: Old admin admin@trillionaitech.com STILL EXISTS in db.users with role='admin' — login with Admin@Trillion2026 still returns 200. Spec explicitly requires it be REMOVED (agent_to_agent_context_note: 'The old admin (admin@trillionaitech.com) is REMOVED — only anselm.perkins@gmail.com exists as master admin now'). seed_admin() in server.py:459 only ensures the NEW admin exists; it never deletes the old one. This is a real security gap because prior credentials still grant god-mode.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py seed_admin(), delete the legacy admin@trillionaitech.com user (and any entitlements bound to its user_id) whenever it differs from the current ADMIN_EMAIL. One-liner fix: `await db.users.delete_one({"email": "admin@trillionaitech.com", "_id": {"$ne": <new admin _id>}})` after seeding the master admin. This removes the surviving prior-iteration admin so only anselm.perkins@gmail.com can hold god-mode.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_admin() upgrades an existing user to admin if email matches new ADMIN_EMAIL, but never removes the previously-seeded admin@trillionaitech.com when the env changes → orphan admin persists (verified in mongo).
appforge.py enforces max prompt 1000 chars and MAX_FILES=20, MAX_FILE_BYTES=30_000 — good hardening. Timeout 90s + returns 504 on timeout — good.

Practically it still works because entitlements are inserted with active:true, but a revoked universal entitlement wouldn't be honored. Minor.
appforge._appforge_has_access DOES require active:true (line 175) — inconsistency with access_codes.user_has_access.

rca of the issue: Symptom: test_old_admin_removed expects login with admin@trillionaitech.com/Admin@Trillion2026 to fail (401) but it returns 200 with role=admin. RCA: seed_admin() in /app/backend/server.py:459-477 only inserts or updates the NEW admin (anselm.perkins@gmail.com) but does not delete the prior admin document that was seeded in an earlier iteration. Verified via mongosh: db.users.find({role:'admin'}) shows TWO admin docs — 6a7e5846...admin@trillionaitech.com AND 6a7e6af0...anselm.perkins@gmail.com. Mitigation: extend seed_admin() to `await db.users.delete_one({"email": "admin@trillionaitech.com"})` when ADMIN_EMAIL != that legacy email. Optionally revoke any entitlements/audit-log ownership rooted at the old admin's _id.
